name: Rank Jet Ai SEO Optimization
author: wpdive

sections.description:
Rankjet.ai is an AI-powered WordPress plugin that helps you optimize your site with:
– AI-generated meta titles and descriptions
– Keyword suggestions
– Content analysis
– Open Graph integration

External Services

This plugin connects to the OpenAI API to provide AI-powered content generation and SEO suggestions.

  • Data Sent: Prompts and context entered by the user and thru the post content and title.
  • Purpose: Generate content suggestions, analyze SEO keywords, and more.
  • Data Processing: OpenAI processes the data to provide a response, but the plugin does not store user data after the interaction.
  • Service: OpenAI (https://openai.com/)
    • Terms of Service: https://openai.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/privacy
    • End point: https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions
sections.installation:
1. Upload rankjet-ai.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the OpenAI API key in the plugin settings.

short_description: Rankjet.ai is an AI-powered SEO optimization plugin for WordPress. Generate meta titles, descriptions, and keywords while analyzing content for SEO.
